p0_bug_fix_verification.bug_description: Stock-Out Lost Sales was showing ₹0 on the frontend despite backend returning correct data
p0_bug_fix_verification.root_cause: MongoDB aggregation migration changed backend response shape (field names and missing aggregated views), but frontend wasn't updated
p0_bug_fix_verification.fix_applied: Enhanced agg_stock_out in /app/backend/core/mongo_aggregations.py to return complete response shape
